user.title: Connect to your relay
user.description: Home Assistant checks the relay's health, then sends one test turn so a refused token is caught now.

data_description.url: The relay's base address, including http or https at the start.
data_description.client_id: The client ID of the Cloudflare Access service token the relay allows.
data_description.client_secret: The client secret of that service token. Home Assistant stores it with this entry and never logs it.

reauth_confirm.title: Replace the Access token
reauth_confirm.description: The relay or Cloudflare Access refused the stored service token. Enter a token the relay allows.

data_description.client_id: The client ID of the Cloudflare Access service token.
data_description.client_secret: The client secret of that service token.

reconfigure.title: Change the relay connection
reconfigure.description: Leave the secret blank to keep the stored one.

data_description.client_id: The client ID of the Cloudflare Access service token.
data_description.client_secret: Leave blank to keep the stored secret.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the relay. Check the URL and that the relay is running.
error.invalid_auth: Cloudflare Access or the relay refused the service token.
error.not_allowed: The relay accepted the token but it is not allowed any profile.
error.invalid_url: Enter an http or https URL.
error.relay_error: The relay reached Claude but the test turn failed. Check the relay's logs.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This relay is already set up.
abort.reauth_successful: The new token works and is saved.
